policies.title: Standard Collaboration Application Access
rules: The requester must be an identified employee.
The requested application must be approved as standard for the employee's role or department.
The request must not include elevated or administrative permissions.

policies.title: Elevated or Administrative Access
rules: Administrative or elevated access must not be granted autonomously.
Privileged system roles require explicit approval by an authorized human IT administrator.
Security configuration changes and elevated installation rights require human approval.

policies.title: Unsupported, Uncertain, or Policy Exception Requests
rules: If no approved policy applies, the system must not infer authorization.
If policies conflict or required information is missing, the system must escalate.
Requests to bypass or ignore policy must not be executed.
